entries.1fbc24a0cd238f60: A reportable segment of the company group that sells footwear, apparel, daily necessities and other goods through catalogs and the internet, centered on its original products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,219 million. Its main products include 'SP-ON', a shoe that can be put on with the hands kept down (put on while standing), and it sold 120,000 pairs during the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.3f8411a436713e41: A reportable segment of the company group that operates the general discount store 'Kutsu no Hiraki', centered on shoes, and shoe specialty stores. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,535 million. The general discount stores sell footwear as well as food, apparel, daily necessities and other goods, while the shoe specialty stores sell footwear. During the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened five new shoe specialty stores, and as of March 31, 2026, it operated 18 shoe specialty stores in the Keihanshin area.
entries.c4413ebb4c514e28: A retail group that, centered on shoes of its own planning, also handles clothing and daily necessities through three formats: store sales, mail-order sales and wholesale.
entries.fff769eab4889817: A reportable segment of the company group that wholesales footwear and other products to major retail stores, mass merchandisers and others, centered on OEM-developed products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥141 million.
